# Sunil Karki — AI & Full-Stack Engineer

> Personal portfolio and technical blog of Sunil Karki, a freelance AI automation specialist and full-stack software engineer based in Nepal.

## About

Sunil Karki is a Computer Science Engineer specializing in:
- Custom AI agent development (Agentic AI)
- AI-powered workflow automation using n8n and custom pipelines
- Full-stack web application development with Next.js, React, Node.js
- AI chatbot development and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines
- SaaS architecture design and implementation

## Services

- **AI Automation & Agents**: Custom AI agents, n8n workflow automation, business process automation
- **Full-Stack Web Development**: Next.js, React, Node.js, TypeScript web applications
- **AI Chatbot Development**: Custom chatbots, RAG pipelines, ChatGPT integrations
- **Technical Consulting**: Architecture reviews, AI strategy, and implementation planning
